title: FF5MenuSprites MenuLayout
description: MenuLayout.json and add-on files (MenuLayout.<name>.json). Units = px at 1440p. Keys starting with _ are notes. Full docs: MenuLayout_README.md. Keep in step with the plugin's Keys.cs.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editors (VS Code). Ignored by the plugin.

log.description: true = log what each rule matched. Main file only.

dumpKey.description: Screen dump key F1-F12; "" = off. Default F8. Main file only.

perf.description: true = [Perf] lines every 5 s (frame times, plugin cost). Main file only.

profileGame.description: true = time the game's own loading ([GameProf] lines). Read at game start. Main file only.

characterNames.description: Saved party name -> shown name, e.g. { "Lenna": "Reina" }. Main file only.

cleanup.description: Forced memory clean-ups after battles, menus and map changes. Main file only.

unloadEveryMinutes.description: Unused-asset sweep at most this often; 0 = game's behaviour.

kupoTextureCache.description: true = reuse a GPU copy of KupoUI's whole-texture replacements. Live. Main file only.

fieldStrideDelay.description: EXPERIMENTAL. fieldSprites: seconds the previous (passing) frame stays into each stride, per walk: "Default" (front), "WalkB" (back), "WalkL" (side). The game shows each walk frame 0.10 s; max 0.09. Live. Main file only.

fieldSpritesDebug.description: Diagnostic: log every frame the game sets on a field character ([FieldDbg], max 400 lines). Leave out or false. Live. Main file only.

fieldSprites.description: EXPERIMENTAL (walk timing still follows the game). true = field (map) character frames from GameAssets/Serial/Res/Chara/Map/MO_FF5_<id>/<frame>.png beside this file (size file <frame>.json pixelsPerUnit). Live. Main file only.

kupoSkipUnreadable.description: Harmful (removes custom menu art); leave out or false. Main file only.

kupoFastUnreadable.description: true = faster KupoUI swap for locked UI textures, same look. Live. Main file only.

textureLimit.description: Texture quality: 0 = full size, 1 = half (the game's own), 2 = quarter. Missing = game's own.

screens.description: Character sprite size and position per menu screen.

styles.description: Named sets of element keys; a rule uses one with "style": "name".

elements.description: Rules for single texts, images and sprites. The first rule that fits an object wins.

textStyles.description: Style for every text of a font type.

renderHeights.description: Camera name -> render height, px; 0 = game's. Main file only.

fitBackground.description: true = show the background's full height.

spritesDown.description: Move party, enemies and effects down, px. Live; 0 = off.

hdPixelsPerUnit.description: HD battle character and enemy textures: texture px per battle unit. 6.667 (default) = a 248 px image shows 248 px tall at 1440p. 0 = off.

customScale.description: On-screen size of replaced party sprites drawn at game-art density (texture up to 2x the game's, e.g. 64 px PSP-style sets), 1.5 = 50% larger. 1 (default) = game size. HD art keeps hdPixelsPerUnit. Needs hdPixelsPerUnit on.

miniScale.description: UNVERIFIED (not yet tested in-game). Mini status: the member keeps its normal job sprites, shown this much smaller (0.5 = half size). Default 0.5; 0 = off (the game's own Mini sprites). Needs hdPixelsPerUnit on.

enemyOnTop.description: Enemy texture-name prefixes (e.g. MN_FF5_127) drawn above the other enemies.

partyRight.description: Move every party member (sprite and shadow) right, px at 1440p; negative = left. Live; 0 = off. Needs hdPixelsPerUnit on.

partyDown.description: Move every party member (sprite and shadow) down, px at 1440p; negative = up. Adds to spritesDown. Live; 0 = off.

partySlots.description: Per party slot (1 = top of the screen): [right, down] px at 1440p, added to partyRight/partyDown. Live.

backRowShift.description: Extra px (1440p) added to the game's back-row distance for back-row party members; negative = closer to the front row. Eases in with the game's slide. Live; 0 = game's.

depthScale.description: Depth look: % smaller a sprite (party, enemies, shadows) is with its feet at the top of the battle view than at the bottom, linear in between; feet stay put. Live; 0 = off.

groundShadow.description: 3D ground shadows computed on the GPU from each sprite's outline and depth map (<sprite>.depth.png). Live.

on.description: false = off (same as leaving the block out).

debug.description: true = show the shadow buffer over the battle: bodies grey by depth (yellow = ground contact, blue tint = lifted), red = the computed shadow. Default false.

azimuth.description: Screen direction the shadow falls, degrees: 0 right, 90 up (away), 180 left, 270 down (toward the camera). Default 45.

elevation.description: Light height, degrees: low = long shadow, 90 = overhead (no length). Default 50.

groundTilt.description: The angle the ground is seen at (sin of the view tilt): how much of the shadow's up/down length shows, and how deep bodies are (a foot drawn higher is farther back). 0.5 matches the HD sprites. Default 0.5.

hideGameShadows.description: true = the game's round shadows stop drawing (flying enemies' always do: their shadow gap is 2 x the gap down to the round shadow's base). Default false.

thickness.description: Rounded depth of each part from its outline, as a share of the image width (added behind the depth map's surface). Default 0.25; 0.15 suits sprites with depth maps.

depthRange.description: Fallback front-to-back depth of a sprite with a depth map, as a share of its width (the map's black-to-white range). Normally the depth scale is solved per sprite so both soles touch the ground; this is used when that fails (log: 'ground fit', debug on) and for flyers. Depth maps: <sprite>.depth.png beside the sprite's PNG (black background, bright = near). Default 0.6.

blur.description: Soft edge, px at 1440p. 0 = sharp. Default 4.

falloff.description: How much lighter the far end is than at the feet (0 = even). Default 0.6.

titleHighlight.description: Title menu highlight. Main file only.

effect.description: false = off; { color, distance, blur } = add or change.

fontStyle.description: Normal/Regular, Bold, Italic, BoldAndItalic, or a face name of the same font, e.g. "SemiBold", "Light Italic".

name.description: Your label (log). In an add-on, the same name replaces an earlier file's rule.

style.description: Shared style name(s); the rule's own keys win.

path.description: The object's path ends with this (F8 dump).

sprite.description: Instead of path: sprite name starts with this.

within.description: The path must also contain this.

text.description: Only texts showing these words (whole text, capitals ignored, * = any letters). Needs path or within. Re-checked when the words change.

fontType.description: Only texts of this font type (Last.UI.FontSelector). Combine with path, within or text; for all texts of a type use textStyles.

nth.description: Only the Nth object with this name under the same parent.

fontScale.description: x the text's own size; 0 = unchanged.

fontSizeMax.description: Largest size for shrink-to-fit text, px.

fontSizeMin.description: Smallest size for shrink-to-fit text, px.

font.description: Loaded or installed font name; "" = unchanged.

merge.description: One box around texts sharing the object this many levels up.

selected.description: While the cursor is on this row.

greyed.description: While the game greys the text out.

radius.description: Rounded corners for a plain box, px.

listPadding.description: Space inside a row/column layout, px: n, [left/right, top/bottom] or [left, right, top, bottom].

listAlign.description: Where a row/column layout puts its items.

width.description: New width, px; any object, containers too (in a layout: layout width).

alpha.description: Opacity of the object and everything under it, 0-1.

image.description: PNG to show instead of the image's sprite, path from this file's folder, e.g. Images/x.png.

hide.description: true = invisible; looks only (keeps its space, still selectable).

match.description: Part of the screen's object path.

top.description: Instead of moveDown: top of the sprite at this y, px.
